description: Use when you need a transaction by hash on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon or Optimism: from, to, value, nonce, gas and fee fields, block, confirmations, method id and input (first 1 KB). Returns the exact paid x402 request for your input (GET /evm/tx, $0.002 per call), with the response schema and an example; call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. Returns the transaction itself; to know whether it succeeded (status, gas used, logs) use evm_receipt. With a P0 access key (header Authorization: Bearer p0k_…, buy one at https://x402-bazaar-rank.x402-bazaar-rank-worker.workers.dev/keys/buy?usd=5) this tool makes the paid call itself and returns the data, deducting the listed price.
name: evm_transaction
title: EVM transaction
